verses.1: Oh, those evil people who destroy and scatter my sheep! Oh, Jehovah!
verses.2: Therefore, as Jehovah God says: “The wicked have destroyed my people. You have scattered my flock; you have scattered them far away from me. But I will punish you for your wickedness. I will deal with you according to your evil deeds.” Amen, Jehovah!
verses.3: And I will gather up all my flocks from all the lands where I have banished them. I will bring them back to their proper places, and they will multiply in number.
verses.4: And I will set upon them evil and destruction. They shall not fear anymore, nor be harmed or destroyed, says the LORD.
verses.5: Look, days are coming, says the Lord. I will establish David as a righteous king and ruler. He will be wise and just, and he will bring justice and righteousness upon the earth.
verses.6: In those days, Judah and Israel will be safe and secure. And that is the name by which Jehovah will be called: “Our Righteousness.”
verses.7: Therefore, see, days are coming, says the LORD. And the LORD will no longer say, “I will raise up the children of Israel from Egypt.”
verses.8: For the Lord who raised them up, and brought forth the seed of Israel from the land of Canaan, from all the lands where they were scattered. Now they will dwell in their own land again.
verses.9: For those who are rebellious, my heart is broken within me. All my hopes have been destroyed. I’ve become like a man who has lost everything. Yehuah has passed by me, and also all His holy words.
verses.10: For the earth is filled with their noise, because of them. But the earth will be desolate and abandoned by them. Their reign will not last long.
verses.11: For both the prophet and the priest were wicked. Even in my house, I found their wickedness. May the LORD have mercy on them!
verses.12: Therefore, their path will be like those of people who are lost in the wilderness. They will be rejected and fall into it, for they will bring upon themselves evil. May Jehovah have mercy on them.
verses.13: And among the prophets of Shomron, I saw prayers being offered for the man. They brought disaster upon my people, Israel.
verses.14: And in the streets of Jerusalem, I saw a woman who was beautiful in appearance. But she walked in deceitfulness. The hands of her enemies became strong, and no one could get rid of her evil ways. All of them were like scorpions to me, and those who lived with her were like snakes.
verses.15: Therefore, as Jehovah’s army says, “I will eat them up and fill them with the waters of life.” For from the prophets of Jerusalem has come a plague upon all the earth.
verses.16: As Jehovah the Lord says: “Do not listen to the words of those who prophesy to you. They are only empty words; their hearts are full of lies. They speak not from the mouth of Jehovah.”
verses.17: They said to Manasseh, “The words of the Lord are true and peaceful for you. May everything proceed in harmony under His rule.” They also said, “May no harm come upon you.”
verses.18: For who can stand in the presence of Jehovah and see and hear His words? Who will listen to His words and obey them?
verses.19: Look! The fierce storm of Jehovah has come upon the heads of the wicked. It will bring destruction upon them.
verses.20: The LORD will not return until He does what He has promised. In those days, He will create new heavens for us to live in.
verses.21: I did not send the messengers. They refused to speak with me, and so they were sent away.
verses.22: And if they stand in my path and listen to my words, then my people will be able to turn from their evil ways. They will be freed from all their evil deeds.
verses.23: The God who is close to me is Jehovah; not a distant God.
verses.24: If someone hides in secret places, I will not find him. But I will surely discover him, says the LORD. I will fill the heavens and the earth with his glory, says the LORD.
verses.25: I heard what the prophets said: “They come in my name, but what they say is false. They say, ‘I’ve dreamed.’ But it’s just a dream.”
verses.26: Until the end, there will always be in the hearts of those who prophesy, prophets of lies and prophets who speak deceitfully.
verses.27: Those who try to forget my name in their thoughts, when they tell one person to another about it, just as their ancestors forgot my name in the past.
verses.28: The prophet who dreams will tell a dream; and he who speaks my words will speak the truth. What is written in the book, let it be fulfilled by Jehovah.
verses.29: Behold, I speak these words like fire. May the LORD speak through me, and may He break through the rocks.
verses.30: Therefore, I am on the high places. May the LORD cry out against those who steal my words from their enemies.
verses.31: I am upon the prophets. May Jehovah’s will be done through them. They are chosen to carry out His commands.
verses.32: I am on the verge of being deceived by false dreams. The LORD says, “They will deceive my people with their lies and deceitfulness.” But I have not sent them or commanded them to do so. They will not be able to harm this people at all, says the LORD.
verses.33: And when this people, or the prophet, or the priest, asks you, “What does Jehovah want?” then you should say to them, “I do not know what Jehovah wants. I will leave you alone.” Amen, Jehovah.
verses.34: And the prophet, the priest, and the people who said, “The Lord has chosen him, and I have appointed him over this man and his house.”
verses.35: So shall you say to one another, and to your brothers: What did Jehovah answer? And what did Jehovah say?
verses.36: And Jehovah will no longer remember those who do evil. For those who do evil will be punished by God. But you, O people of God, may you make the words of God come to life again. May Jehovah, our God, protect us!
verses.37: So say to the prophet: What has Jehovah answered you? And what is Jehovah’s word?
verses.38: And if Jehovah says to you, “As Jehovah has said, so shall it be,” then Jehovah will send someone to tell you that you should not say, “Mashash Jehovah.”
verses.39: Therefore, I will carry you away and leave you here. I will also abandon the city that I have given to you and to your ancestors.
verses.40: And I will give you the shame of eternity, and the disgrace of eternal damnation, so that you will never be able to escape them.
